name: Extensão Chrome monetizada (for enterprises)
notes: Enterprise variant emphasizes security, SSO/SAML, and admin console. Proxy TIER0 via GitHub Search for enterprise browser management extensions. Official targets: Chrome Enterprise Policy API + Google Workspace Marketplace. Monetization via volume licensing agreements. Zero-capital PoC uses self-signed policies + mock IdP; production requires verified publisher status (free but time-gated).
